name: GE® 36" 27.7 Cu. Ft. Fingerprint Resistant Stainless Side-By-Side Refrigerator with LED Light Walls and Extra Tall Dispenser
shortDescription: It's easy to stay organized with extra room to store large or bulk food items with 27.7 cubic feet of storage space. Protect your groceries with a door alarm that signals when a door has accidentally been left open.

features.text: LED Light Walls
Two, bright LED Light Walls help illuminate every corner of your fridge and freezer, allowing you to see everything and find it fast.
Extra Tall Water Dispenser
Easily access filtered water and ice from an extra tall, 11-inch water dispenser made to fill everyone in the family’s favorite water bottle.
In-Door Icemaker
Located on the freezer door to create more usable shelf storage space. Dispense cubed and crushed ice through the door.
Extra Large Adjustable Door Bins

Move the clear door bins up and down to fit your storage needs – whether it’s large gallons, tall bottles, or everyday essentials. Four of the fresh food bins are extra large, which means you can fit two gallons of milk plus more, all in just one bin.
Two Freezer Storage Drawers
Upgrade your storage game with two freezer drawers that give bagged frozen items a place of their own, making it easier to sort, store, and find exactly what you need.
Adjustable Fresh Food Shelves
Store more of your favorite tall items like milk cartons and two-liters with adjustable refrigerator shelves.
Wide Fresh Food Shelves
Take advantage of wide, wall-to-wall glass shelves - perfect for storing party platters, half baking sheets, and more.
Adjustable Freezer Shelves
Organize your way with three adjustable freezer shelves that allow you to store 12-inch frozen pizza boxes flat or standing.
Two Fresh Food Storage Drawers
Two spacious fresh-food drawers give your family plenty of room to store produce, lunch essentials, and all the little extras that keep the week moving.
Built-In Wi-Fi, Powered by SmartHQ™
Adjust the brightness of your LED Light Walls, control temperature settings, receive high temperature alerts, door alarm alerts, manage your icemaker, check your water filter status, and more.
Advanced Water and Ice Filtration
The included refrigerator water filter reduces 50+ impurities including lead, chlorine, microplastics, and PFOA/PFOS; providing clean, safe drinking water and ice.
Internal Temperature Controls
Moving the temperature controls to the fresh food section gives you a modern exterior.
MultiVent Cooling
Multiple vents distribute air flow to help keep set temperatures consistent.
